summary: A 20-year-old Michigan man attempting to winter-camp in the Cement Creek drainage was reported to Gunnison Dispatch and contacted by Crested Butte Search and Rescue on a Saturday; he was very cold and not alright in his tent where snowmobiles turn around, and CBSAR brought him out of the wilderness; medically cleared and put up at a hostel for the night
